errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the category "От всички" (Of all) as a time point. This category represents an aggregate total, not a point in time like April 2021 or August 2021.

The description fails to mention the dotted vertical line that visually separates the "От всички" category from the other two categories, which is a key structural element indicating the different nature of this data group.
